updates.title: Latest Updates
items: Work on the new water supply scheme under Gram Panchayat Sategaon is in progress.
The revised budget for the financial year 2025–26 has been approved by the Gram Sabha.
Please cooperate with the property tax and water tax collection campaign.
Sategaon has received an 'A' grade under the Swachh Bharat Mission.
